_comment: Constants for the energy model of EVALUATION.md section 4, in one place so
the pending GWDG reply and the section 8 sensitivity sweep are config edits
rather than code edits. Every value replaced by GWDG data should have its
source changed from 'assumed' to 'gwdg' and be marked as such in the thesis

hardware._source: KISSKI inference platform page + NVIDIA H100 PCIe datasheet (assumed)

_default._comment: Applied to any model in the run log without its own entry.
_default._source: devstral-2-123b-instruct-2512 model card; BF16 assumed - verify

serving._comment: Concurrency is the single largest unknown; see section 8.

facility._source: GWDG press release 4/2021 (Emmy, 2021 - replace with GWDG reply); Umweltbundesamt

_comment: repair_stages lists the pipeline task ids whose energy is repair rather
than first-pass translation, so the tool can report the repair share
without hardcoding task names it cannot know.
They must match the task ids of the pipeline that produced the run log

sensitivity._comment: Ranges swept by -sweep to produce the section 8 table.
